rationale: No confirmed break either way since the morning REDUCE: reduceIf (82,874.5) held as support (session low 83,340.9 never re-tested it), and addIf (84,628.2) stayed unbroken despite an intrabar wick to 84,944.4 that closed back down at 83,669.9 on the 09:00 COT candle -- the breakout attempt was rejected intracandle. Daily structure is unchanged (bullish, above all EMAs) but MACD histogram keeps decelerating for a 5th session. Holding the post-REDUCE spot core and staying flat on futures rather than chasing a mid-range print with no settled-close edge.

message.text: Post-flush range held again this session: low 83,340.9, wicked to 84,944.4 but no settled close above addIf (84,628.2). If endday sees a confirmed close through either 84,628.2 or 82,874.5, that's the real signal -- otherwise this is still a box. Watch the overnight liquidity: fresh realized liquidations this run sit almost entirely above spot (84,250-85,000, ~705 BTC), with a short-liquidation cluster at 84,750 the nearest overhead friction.

lesson.insight: After a liquidation-driven flush, expect a multi-session range between the flush low and the last pre-flush swing high before a directional confirmation. An intrabar wick through a decision level (here, 84,944.4 through the 84,628.2 addIf) is not itself a signal -- wait for a settled candle close before acting.
